dogecoin.text: Today two major sports teams adopted #DogeCoin as payment for tickets/merch. This is getting so silly but it's what the world needs after a year of lockdowns. A dog themed meme digital currency with snoop dog and elon musk promoting it. Its insane. We needed this.

The quarter in your pocket is worth less than one DogeCoin, a digital currency based off a dog meme that has no physical presence and was started as a joke. 
Fiat is dying. Inflation is coming. Savings are pointless.
